mapper.sql: SELECT mr.id, (CASE WHEN mr.comment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS report_type, (CASE WHEN mr.comment_id IS NOT NULL THEN mr.comment_id ELSE mr.moment_id END) AS target_id, mr.report_user_id, ru.nick_name AS report_user_name, mr.reason, mr.description, mr.status, mr.handle_user_id, mr.handle_time, mr.handle_note, mr.handle_action, mr.create_time, LEFT(COALESCE(m.content, mc.content), 120) AS content_excerpt FROM moment_report mr LEFT JOIN moment m ON mr.moment_id = m.moment_id LEFT JOIN moment_comment mc ON mr.comment_id = mc.comment_id LEFT JOIN user_info ru ON mr.report_user_id = ru.user_id UNION ALL SELECT msgr.id, 3 AS report_type, msgr.message_id AS target_id, msgr.report_user_id, ru2.nick_name AS report_user_name, msgr.reason, msgr.description, msgr.status, msgr.handle_user_id, msgr.handle_time, msgr.handle_note, msgr.handle_action, msgr.create_time, LEFT(cm.message_content, 120) AS content_excerpt FROM message_report msgr LEFT JOIN chat_message cm ON msgr.message_id = cm.message_id LEFT JOIN user_info ru2 ON msgr.report_user_id = ru2.user_id
